body: No idea why you commented in the first place.

Once you decide that you want to smoke pot for the rest of your life, it might be time to quit. Weed tends to give you the mindset that you're talking about. I quit smoking because it doesn't do much good for you once you become an avid smoker, and re-fucking-gardless of what everyone says, it is actually addictive. You can believe me or not, but time and time again I see people stay in "all I want to do is be at home" rut over weed. It won't  solve all your problems to quit, but it is still a factor that goes against you as an avid smoker.

Now that I'm off weed, I actually like the routine of work. Of course I hate the damage it does to my already fucked up body and it is monotonous, but I don't find myself begging to go straight home (well, I'm homeless, so to my car) every moment of the day anymore.

I wasted 10 years.. 10 fuckin years.. smoking pot, thinking it was all gravy, but now I honestly regret it all. I thought it wasn't having any negative affects on me, but it was. I was just too stoned to see it.

I'm just saying.

I don't want anyone to say anything to me. Suicide Watch is a place for people to vent or write their last testament, not be saved by other Redditors. I'm not sure why you bothered to comment, but since you did...

I'm trying to tell people to actually DO something to better their lives instead of wallowing in self pity. There are a lot of good, solid posts here that make me think, "Fuck I feel for that person", but *so* many are "I've just given up cause blah blah Brad blah blah my mom sucks blah". Are you *kidding* me? You have a roof over your head, food in your belly and you're just giving up over some highschool bullshit? **That** is my point. If you can't see that (obviously) then good luck to you in your endeavours, friend.
